subject: eng
title: Learning English: my goals and strategies
goal: Вивчити лексику теми навчання мови, повторити Present Perfect і Past Simple та розповісти про свій досвід вивчення англійської.

theory.text: Минулого уроку ми говорили, чому англійська важлива. Сьогодні — про **твої цілі** та **способи навчання**. Чітка мета й стратегія допомагають навчатися швидше, а ще — розповісти про свій досвід англійською, що часто потрібно на співбесіді та усному іспиті.

items.ex: A language certificate is a useful qualification.
In my leisure time I watch films in English.
My main goal is to study abroad.
I want to improve my vocabulary.
Reading helps me improve my writing.
I practise speaking with my friend.
Don't be afraid of making mistakes.
She has made great progress this year.

lines.text: Have you ever thought about your goals in English?
Yes. I want to get a good qualification, because I'd like to study abroad.
How have you been preparing so far?
I have watched a lot of videos and I have read several short books. Last month I started a speaking club.
Great! I have never joined a club, but I practised with an online partner last week.

theory.title: Present Perfect
theory.text:
**Present Perfect** = have/has + третя форма дієслова (V3). Вживаємо, коли важливий **результат** або **досвід** до теперішнього моменту, а час дії не названо: *I have read three books. She has never been to London.*
Маркери: ever, never, already, yet, just, so far, since, for, this week/month.
Питання: *Have you ever ...? — Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.*

theory.title: Present Perfect чи Past Simple?
theory.text:
**Past Simple** — коли названо або мається на увазі **конкретний завершений час**: yesterday, last week, in 2023, two days ago.
*I have visited Kyiv.* (досвід, коли — неважливо)
*I visited Kyiv last summer.* (названо час)

theory.title: Порівняння
head: Present Perfect
Past Simple
rows: I have finished my project. (результат зараз)
I finished my project yesterday. (конкретний час)
She has learnt 50 words this week. (тиждень ще триває)
She learnt 50 words last week. (тиждень завершився)
Have you ever spoken to a native speaker?
When did you speak to a native speaker?

theory.text: Розповідь про досвід зазвичай починають Present Perfect (*I have studied English for ten years*), а подробиці продовжують у Past Simple (*I started at school when I was seven*).

exercises.q: Що Макс сказав про свою підготовку у діалозі?
options: He has watched videos and read short books.
He joined a club two years ago.
He doesn't want to study abroad.

exercises.text: I {have read} two books in English this month. She {has never} visited Britain. (read; never)
We {started} the project last Monday and {finished} it on Friday. (start, finish)

options: I have seen this film yesterday.
I have saw this film yesterday.
exercises.explain: Є конкретний час yesterday, тому потрібен Past Simple: saw.

exercises.q: Розподіли речення за часом, який у них потрібен.

Present Perfect: I have just finished my homework.
Past Simple: I finished my homework an hour ago.
Did you go abroad last summer?

exercises.q: Прочитай вголос діалог з Олею (Olena) разом із вигаданим партнером, звертаючи увагу на інтонацію питань.
exercises.text: Have you ever thought about your goals in English? Yes. I want to get a good qualification, because I'd like to study abroad.

homework.q: Поставте дієслова в потрібну форму: Present Perfect або Past Simple.
homework.text: I {have studied} English for six years. I {started} learning it when I was eight. (study, start)

homework.q: Який вираз належить до Present Perfect?
homework.explain: So far (поки що) вказує на період, який триває до теперішнього моменту.

homework.q: Write 6–8 sentences about your English learning: What are your goals? What strategies have you tried? What have you already achieved? Use Present Perfect and Past Simple, and at least four words from the vocabulary.
homework.sample: My main goal is to get a good qualification in English. I have been learning it for eight years. Last year I started watching films without subtitles, and it has improved my vocabulary a lot. I have also practised speaking with my friends. So far I have made good progress, but I still make mistakes in grammar.

reflection: Яка моя головна ціль у вивченні англійської?
Чи відрізняю я Present Perfect від Past Simple?
